midnight-plum.$description: Midnight Plum — Page canvas, primary dark surface — the near-black with a violet undertone that gives the UI its cool, secure temperature

shadow-plum.$description: Shadow Plum — Elevated card surface, input fields, nested panels — one step lighter than canvas to suggest depth without a shadow

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary text, icon strokes, button labels on dark — warm off-white avoids the sterile feel of pure white against violet-black

fog-line.$description: Fog Line — Hairline borders, dividers, card outlines — the most-used neutral in the system, defining every container edge

ash-veil.$description: Ash Veil — Muted secondary text, disabled labels, ghost button text — sits between white and mid-gray for tertiary hierarchy

mid-ash.$description: Mid Ash — Muted helper text, placeholder copy, secondary metadata — low-priority text that recedes

iron-edge.$description: Iron Edge — Subtle dividers, input borders in resting state — barely visible structural lines

lavender-spark.$description: Lavender Spark — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

signal-green.$description: Signal Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

neon-violet.$description: Neon Violet — Radial gradient anchor, deep brand violet used in decorative aurora effects behind hero text

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Terminal color in the violet-to-orange hero gradient — adds warmth to the cool palette at the gradient terminus

plasma-pink.$description: Plasma Pink — Radial gradient origin point — the pink hotspot in the aurora glow behind the hero

doppler-repro.$description: Single-family system — custom geometric sans handling everything from 12px captions to 96px displays. Weight 450 is the signature workhorse (slightly heavier than 400 but lighter than 500), giving text a distinctive medium-confident feel. At 64px+ sizes, letter-spacing tightens to -0.02em for compressed, engineered headlines; at 12px it opens to 0.03em for readable small text. Replaces the visual job that a secondary serif or monospace would do on other sites — consistency over contrast.
